_sources: Generated parts: build_wiki.py fills cards.maxStack / age from core/upgrade/UpgradeKind.java, the slots and caps of 'rule': 'mk' rows from the Mk rule (UpgradeRules.mkSlots / mkCap, defaults from CoreConfig speedCapPerMk, efficiencyCapPerMk, rangeCapPerMk, fortuneCapMax) and of 'rule': 'fixed:<NAME>' rows from UpgradeRules.Fixed.

Hand-written: names, summaries and the effect of each card per machine. Kinds of a Mk row = its effects keys; keep them equal to the machine's accepted kinds in Java (UpgradeRuleGameTests checks the Java side).

Effects: Upgrades.speedMultiplier (x2 ... x20), Upgrades.energyMultiplier (-15% per efficiency card, floor 40%), steepEnergyMultiplier for the Excavator and Survey Rig, dropEnergyMultiplier (CoreConfig fortuneEnergyPerCard) and bonusFortuneEnergyMultiplier for Fortune and Silk Touch.

speed.name: Speed Upgrade
speed.summary: Machines work faster and use more FE per action.
speed.rules: Each card is one step: x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20.

efficiency.name: Efficiency Upgrade
efficiency.summary: Machines use 15% less FE per action per card. Combustion Generator: 10% less fuel per card.
efficiency.rules: Never below 40% of the base cost.

range.name: Range Upgrade
range.summary: Bigger work area or range, more items per Electric Furnace lane.
range.rules: What a step means depends on the machine.

fortune.name: Fortune Upgrade
fortune.summary: Fortune I-III on mined blocks, more Grinder output, Looting in the Replicator.
fortune.rules: Each card: +50% FE (Grinder +25%). Not together with a Silk Touch card.

silk.name: Silk Touch Upgrade
silk.rules: Single card, +100% FE. Not together with Fortune.

growth.name: Growth Upgrade
growth.summary: Farm bots: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.

void.name: Void Upgrade
void.summary: Deletes junk or outputs that don't fit.

height.name: Height Upgrade
height.summary: Architect Table: buildings one block taller per card.

effects.speed: Grinds faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises with it.
effects.fortune: +10% main output per card on ores and raw ores, not gem ores; +25% FE/t each there.
effects.void: Extra outputs that don't fit are deleted instead of stalling.

effects.speed: Smelts faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20).
effects.range: +1 item per lane and cycle per card.

effects.speed: Faster crafts (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises.
Faster crafts (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises.
effects.void: Chance results that don't fit vanish instead of stalling.

effects.speed: Faster crafts (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises.
Presses faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20).
FE/t x2, x3, x4, x6; fuel burns faster still (more fuel per FE).
effects.efficiency: -10% fuel per FE per card (4 cards: 1.67x FE per fuel item).

effects.speed: Fells each tree sooner after reaching it (x2 to x20); FE use rises with it.
effects.range: +6 blocks wide per card on every Mk (7x7 up to 31x31).
effects.growth: Saplings in the area grow +50% faster per card.

effects.speed: Harvests, tills and plants each 3x3 sooner (x2 to x20); FE use rises with it.
effects.range: +6 blocks wide per card on every Mk (9x9 up to 33x33).
effects.growth: Crops in the area grow +50% faster per card.

effects.speed: Feeds, breeds, shears and culls more often (x2 to x6); FE per action rises with it.
effects.range: +6 blocks wide per card on every Mk (9x9 up to 33x33).

effects.speed: Charges faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20 FE/t per player).
Digs faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE per block x1.75 / x3 / x7 / x21 at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 cards.
effects.range: Hole +10 blocks wide per card (Mk1 8 -> 18, Mk4 24 -> 64).

effects.silk: Blocks drop themselves; FE per block x2.
effects.void: Deletes cobblestone, dirt, gravel and other junk.

effects.speed: More ores (x2 ... x20); FE/t climbs much faster: x3.5 / x9 / x42 / x420 at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 cards.

effects.silk: Ores come out as ore blocks; FE/t x2.

effects.fortune: Looting I-III on the mob's loot; FE/t x1.5 / x2 / x2.5 in Harvest mode.
